raw_text: Pakistan Air Force has received the initial tranche of JF-17 Thunder Block 3 multirole combat aircraft manufactured by Chengdu Aircraft Corporation and Pakistan Aeronautical Complex. Jane's understands the Block 3 integrates the Nanjing Research Institute of Electronics Technology KLJ-7A AESA fire control radar and is wired for PL-15E beyond-visual-range missiles. The aircraft features a wide-angle holographic HUD and a new glass cockpit with three large-area displays.
clean_text: Pakistan Air Force received initial JF-17 Block 3 aircraft with KLJ-7A AESA radar, PL-15E BVR missile wiring, wide-angle holographic HUD, and new glass cockpit with three large-area displays.
